A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same PIFA/MPIFA paper with complete, readable main text and Appendices A–G. Text and rendered-page comparisons establish that the content matches apart from the first-page arXiv version/date stamp.

before.justification: v2 reports original perplexity, inference-efficiency and ablation experiments in Section 5, plus C4, SuperGLUE, structured-pruning and ESPACE evaluations in the appendices.

after.justification: v3 retains these original empirical results, including benchmark scores, measured speedup and memory usage, and component ablations in the main text and appendices.

M1.justification: Algorithms 1–3 retain identical pivoting factorization and online reconstruction procedures. The mixed reconstruction target, updates to both factors, regularization and nonuniform-sparsity variant also match.

E1.justification: Both versions use WikiText2 and C4 for language-model evaluation and fine-tuning, and the same eight SuperGLUE tasks for zero-shot evaluation. Layerwise and end-to-end inference scenarios are unchanged.

E2.justification: Corresponding comparisons retain SVD, ASVD, SVD-LLM, magnitude/Wanda/RIA 2:4 pruning, LLM-Pruner and the same four ESPACE variants. No evaluated comparator is added or removed.

E3.justification: Section 5 and Appendix B retain the same model configurations, density settings, calibration sample counts, sequence lengths and fine-tuning protocol. SuperGLUE metrics and GPU benchmarking settings also match.

E4.justification: Section 5.3 retains the component, mixing-ratio, calibration-size and factor-reconstruction ablations. Figure 8's condition-number analysis and Appendix G's component comparisons across pruning methods are unchanged.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting is identical. Neither version adds or removes repeated-run counts, seed information, uncertainty intervals or significance tests.

E6.justification: All result entries and plotted findings in Tables 2–15 and Figures 4–8 match. For example, MPIFA's LLaMA2-7B WikiText2 perplexity at 50% density remains 12.77, and its corresponding SuperGLUE mean remains 52.9.

T1.justification: The parameter-count and computational-cost derivations, Equations 1–9, and Appendix A's closed-form reconstruction proof retain identical mathematics and assumptions.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same claims about lossless compression through PIFA, error-accumulation reduction through M, and MPIFA's performance and efficiency relative to other pruning approaches.

C2.justification: Interpretations concerning calibration overfitting, matrix conditioning and applicability across pruning methods are unchanged. Section 6 retains the limitation that PIFA requires an existing low-rank method and does not itself reduce matrix rank.

D1.justification: Appendix B's implementation and hyperparameter details and Appendix F's resource information are identical. The code-access link is unchanged; only the arXiv stamp's self-link updates to v3.

R1.justification: Section 2, the bibliography and appendix citations match. Positioning relative to low-rank, semi-structured and structured pruning methods is unchanged.

P1.justification: The first-page arXiv stamp changes from v2 dated 10 Jun 2025 to v3 dated 13 Aug 2025. The paper's prose, terminology, headings and section order are otherwise identical.

P2.justification: Figures 1–8, Tables 1–15, captions, placement and page layout are unchanged. Pages 2–22 render identically; page 1 differs only in the text of the existing margin stamp.

improvement.justification: v3 retains the same scientific content, evidence, explanations and limitations throughout the main text and appendices. Updating the arXiv version/date stamp and its self-link produces no meaningful difference in rigor, clarity, completeness or reproducibility.
